name: exists_equalRankThetaRatio_value
summary: Compare W with J = I_{2k} plus planes. If all ratios vanished, the descended exchange identity at the standard datum would give a contradiction; otherwise the two exchange identities between J and the zero space, multiplied, show that the square of the ratio is B·C·|⟨vac at 0⟩|², the same for every 𝔠.

steps.claim: Let J be the standard definite space of rank 2k.
steps.lean: let J := stdSpace E (Fin (2 * k))

steps.claim: A space X with the signs s and a base-adapted splitting A of X over J along negCount(s) planes (`exists_isBaseAdapted`).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨X, A, _⟩ := exists_isBaseAdapted (Fin _) J s (by simpa) (by simp)

steps.claim: Let Y = hypSum(Unit, X), X plus one hyperbolic plane.
steps.lean: let Y := hypSum Unit X

steps.claim: Let P = removePlanes(Unit, X), the splitting of Y over X along the line.
steps.lean: let P := removePlanes Unit X

steps.claim: Let Q = P∘A, the splitting of Y over J.
steps.lean: let Q := P.comp A

steps.claim: Let Z be the zero space.
steps.lean: let Z := stdSpace E Empty

steps.claim: The constant 1 on U(J) is rapid (o); and either every equalRankThetaRatio(Y, 𝔠, v) with v rapid vanishes (h₀), or some 𝔠 and rapid v₁ give a non-zero value (h).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨o, h₀ | ⟨_, v₁, r₁, h⟩⟩ := (J.isAutomorphic_const 1).mem_rapidFunctions,
    em' (∃ 𝔠 v, IsRapidDatum v ∧ equalRankThetaRatio Y 𝔠 v ≠ 0)

steps.claim: First case: unfolded, h₀ says that thetaLarge(Y, Y, 𝔠, v, stdColDatum(χ_𝔠, 1))(1) = 0 for every 𝔠 and rapid v.
steps.lean: simp [equalRankThetaRatio, ne_of_gt, -thetaIntegral] at h₀

steps.claim: First case, continued: descend with `exists_stdExchange_removing_planes` (for J.neg, Y, Z, the weights k and μ − k) the identity StdExchange given by `stdExchange_of_periods` with l = 0 and ρ = 1, for the datum v that its part (2) gives with f(v) = the vacuum determinant vector; from the resulting StdExchange the conclusion is read with v = the vacuum and C = 1.
steps.lean:
refine (exists_stdExchange_removing_planes J.neg _ ((removePlanes _ Y).symm.comp Q) μ k
    (μ · - k |>.toNat) Z (sumEmpty ..) (sumAssoc ..).symm ?_ ?_).rec fun f ⟨K, a⟩ ↦
    (a ?_ ?_ ?_ ⟨isRapidDatum_vacVector, 1, 0, ?_⟩).rec fun v ⟨⟨r, _⟩, a⟩ ↦ (a ▸ K _ 0 <|
    stdExchange_of_periods _ (removePlanes _ Y) P _ 0 ?q zero_le_one ?_ r ?_ (fun 𝔠 _ ↦ ⟨1, by
    simp_intro .. [realSlice]; exact And.elim (fun i R ↦ .trans (by
      congr with
      rw [IsVacuum.map_eq_integral]
      convert! (θ _ ∘L (pairWeil ..) _ ∘L (integrated _).flip _).integral_comp_comm i
      rw [map_smul, map_smul]
      convert! congrArg _ (thetaOnRealData_boxProd_eq_mul ..)
      erw [← heisOp_tmul, tmul_vacElem]) ((thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank P _ ?q R _).trans
      (h₀ _ _ R))) (isRapidDatum_integral (by fun_prop) fun _ ↦ (eq_top_mono
      (lintegral_weightedNorm_smul_le fun y ↦ by grw [weightedNorm_smul, weightedNorm_realHeisOp_le,
      ← ofReal_norm, (thetaOnRealData ..).le_opNorm, Heisenberg.Rep.norm_map,
      (enorm_le_iff_norm_le.2 (pi_norm_comp_le y _) : ‖Prod.snd _‖ₑ ≤ _), mul_comm, mul_rotate])).mt
      (by simp [mul_eq_top, isRapidDatum_vacVector _, realPairWeil, weightedNorm_smul,
      isRapidDatum_slice _ _ r _, (eq_top_mono (weightedNorm_realWeil_le ..)).mt]))⟩) ?_).2.2.rec
    fun _ K ↦ ⟨_, isRapidDatum_vacVector, 1, ?_,
    fun 𝔠 ↦ by simpa [↓isIntegralUnit_iff_v_eq_one, univ_eq_empty, @eq_one (G ..),
    (id rfl : stdRowDatum (sumEmpty ..) _ 1 _ = stdColDatum _ 1 1)] using
    (K 𝔠).choose_spec.2 _ .one⟩ <;> simp +arith [IsRapidDatum, weightedNorm, detVectorFn, *]

steps.claim: The period condition of `stdExchange_of_periods`: by the integral representation of the model (`Heisenberg.IsVacuum.map_eq_integral`), the interchange with the theta functional, the factorization of thetaOnRealData over box products (`thetaOnRealData_boxProd_eq_mul`) and the tensor of vacua, the integral over [U(W₁)] is a multiple of the equal-rank theta integral of Y with the slice of v;
steps.lean:
simp_intro .. [realSlice]; exact And.elim (fun i R ↦ .trans (by
      congr with
      rw [IsVacuum.map_eq_integral]
      convert! (θ _ ∘L (pairWeil ..) _ ∘L (integrated _).flip _).integral_comp_comm i
      rw [map_smul, map_smul]
      convert! congrArg _ (thetaOnRealData_boxProd_eq_mul ..)
      erw [← heisOp_tmul, tmul_vacElem])

steps.claim: that equal-rank theta integral is constant (`thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank`) and vanishes by h₀, so the period condition holds with l = 0.
steps.lean:
((thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank P _ ?q R _).trans
      (h₀ _ _ R)))

steps.claim: The datum is rapid (`isRapidDatum_integral`): its weighted norms are bounded by those of the vacuum, of the slice of v and of the Weil translates (`lintegral_weightedNorm_smul_le`, `weightedNorm_realHeisOp_le`, `MixedModel.isRapidDatum_slice`, `weightedNorm_realWeil_le`).
steps.lean:
(isRapidDatum_integral (by fun_prop) fun _ ↦ (eq_top_mono
      (lintegral_weightedNorm_smul_le fun y ↦ by grw [weightedNorm_smul, weightedNorm_realHeisOp_le,
      ← ofReal_norm, (thetaOnRealData ..).le_opNorm, Heisenberg.Rep.norm_map,
      (enorm_le_iff_norm_le.2 (pi_norm_comp_le y _) : ‖Prod.snd _‖ₑ ≤ _), mul_comm, mul_rotate])).mt
      (by simp [mul_eq_top, isRapidDatum_vacVector _, realPairWeil, weightedNorm_smul,
      isRapidDatum_slice _ _ r _, (eq_top_mono (weightedNorm_realWeil_le ..)).mt]))⟩) ?_).2.2.rec

steps.claim: With the vacuum and C = 1, every 𝔠 satisfies the identity read from the exchange at the standard datum 1 (`isIntegralUnit_iff_v_eq_one`, the trivial groups of the empty index sets); the conditions on ranks, signs and determinant vectors hold by arithmetic.
steps.lean:
fun _ K ↦ ⟨_, isRapidDatum_vacVector, 1, ?_,
    fun 𝔠 ↦ by simpa [↓isIntegralUnit_iff_v_eq_one, univ_eq_empty, @eq_one (G ..),
    (id rfl : stdRowDatum (sumEmpty ..) _ 1 _ = stdColDatum _ 1 1)] using
    (K 𝔠).choose_spec.2 _ .one⟩ <;> simp +arith [IsRapidDatum, weightedNorm, detVectorFn, *]

steps.claim: Second case: `exchange_of_partners` for (Z, J) along Q: B, a rapid y, constants b(𝔠) with B|b|² = Π·equalRankThetaRatio(Y, 𝔠, v₁) (hb) and the identities K.
steps.lean: choose B y r b hb K using exchange_of_partners Z μ Q J (emptySum ..) r₁ isRapidDatum_vacVector

steps.claim: And `exchange_of_partners` for (J, Z): C, x, constants c(𝔠) (hc) and the identities H.
steps.lean: choose C x _ c hc H using exchange_of_partners J μ Q Z (sumEmpty ..) r₁ r

steps.claim: Conclude from the claim F below: equalRankThetaRatio(Y, 𝔠, v₁)² = B·C·|⟨vac at 0⟩|² for every 𝔠, so the ratio (non-negative) is the same constant for all 𝔠; with `thetaLarge_move` (comparing Y with the space of `Space.exists_eq_move`) and `thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank` this gives v₁ and C as required (C ≠ 0 by h).
steps.lean:
refine have F 𝔠 : equalRankThetaRatio Y 𝔠 v₁ ^ 2 =
      B * C * ‖integrated _ x (J.hom Z).vacElem 0‖ ^ 2 := ?_
    ⟨_, r₁, _, h, fun 𝔠 ↦ by rw [← sq_eq_sq₀, F, ← F 𝔠, equalRankThetaRatio,
      (thetaLarge_move _ _ _ Y _ _ (exists_eq_move
      ..).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.1 𝔠).choose_spec, thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank P] <;>
      simp [Y, *, equalRankThetaRatio, div_nonneg, _root_.le_of_lt, -thetaIntegral]⟩

steps.claim: Claim F: for every 𝔠, equalRankThetaRatio(Y, 𝔠, v₁)² = B·C·|⟨vac at 0⟩|² (proved in steps 13–18).
steps.lean:
have F 𝔠 : equalRankThetaRatio Y 𝔠 v₁ ^ 2 =
      B * C * ‖integrated _ x (J.hom Z).vacElem 0‖ ^ 2 := ?_
    ⟨_, r₁, _, h, fun 𝔠 ↦ by rw [← sq_eq_sq₀, F, ← F 𝔠, equalRankThetaRatio,
      (thetaLarge_move _ _ _ Y _ _ (exists_eq_move
      ..).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.1 𝔠).choose_spec, thetaLarge_eq_apply_one_of_even_rank P] <;>
      simp [Y, *, equalRankThetaRatio, div_nonneg, _root_.le_of_lt, -thetaIntegral]⟩

steps.claim: Lift and descent are adjoint for the constant 1 on J (`ThetaKernel.integral_lift_eq_integral_descent`).
steps.lean: have T α φ := (pairThetaKer _ _ α α).integral_lift_eq_integral_descent (φ := φ) o o

steps.claim: K at the partners of the empty frame (stdRowDatum, stdColDatum of 1, `isPartner_stdRowDatum_stdColDatum`).
steps.lean:
specialize K 𝔠 (stdColDatum _ 1) _ (.of_discrete _)
    (isPartner_stdRowDatum_stdColDatum _ (s := 0) nofun)

steps.claim: Integrate H at the standard data over [U(J)] and take absolute values.
steps.lean:
have := congr(‖∫ g, $(H 𝔠 (fun _ ↦ stdColDatum _ 1 1) _ (stdColDatum_mem_schwartzBruhat _ .one).1
    (isPartner_stdRowDatum_stdColDatum _ IsIntMatrix.one) g) ∂J.quotMeasure‖)

steps.claim: Simplify T, K and the last identity with the empty index sets (integral units, trivial groups, the definition of the lift).
steps.lean:
simp [↓isIntegralUnit_iff_v_eq_one, ↓IsIntMatrix.one, IsIntMatrix, lift, field, univ_eq_empty,
    @eq_one (G ..), mul_right_comm _ _⁻¹] at T K this

steps.claim: Substitute everywhere.
steps.lean: simp [*, field] at *

steps.claim: Combine the norm relations hb and hc with the positivity of the L-value products (`lValueProdInt_pos`): F holds.
steps.lean: rw [this]; clear * - hc hb; grind [lValueProdInt, lValueProdInt_pos]
